from harvests import load_harvests, ROWS
from naming import label_harvests

NAMES = ["n%d" % i for i in range(len(ROWS))]


def test_lines_present():
    lookup, lines = label_harvests(NAMES, load_harvests())
    assert len(lines) == len(ROWS)


def test_lookup():
    lookup, lines = label_harvests(NAMES, load_harvests())
    assert lookup["n0"] == ROWS[0][1]
